meta.description: ICHU by SmartFarm: livestock monitoring with smart collars, herd records, and veterinary history.

terms.authentication: Sign-in is handled by Firebase Authentication. The ICHU API checks your account and ranch permissions before showing ranch data. Passwords are sent only to Firebase Authentication and are never stored by the application.
terms.records: ICHU stores collar telemetry and ranch records for each ranch, and shows them only to accounts with access to that ranch.
terms.preferences: Your selected language and ranch are stored in this browser.
terms.payments: Payments are processed by Stripe. ICHU never stores card data.
terms.contact: Contact SmartFarm about these terms or your data.

notFound.body: Check the address or return to your ICHU account.

login.title: Welcome back
login.note: Sign-in is checked by the ICHU account service.
login.navigationFailed: Your workspace could not open. Try again.

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Full name
register.ranchDetailsNote: These details create your initial ranch account.
register.ranchDetailsRequired: Complete all ranch details and enter a positive whole number for herd size.
register.terms: I agree to the ICHU Terms of Use.
register.termsRequired: Confirm that you agree before continuing.
register.passwordNote: Your password is sent to Firebase Authentication and is never included in this review.
register.retryNotice: Account setup is not complete. Retry with the same email and password to finish it.
register.verifyNotice: Your account was created. Check your inbox for a Firebase verification email before signing in.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.lead: Enter the email address for your ICHU account.
recovery.note: If an account exists for this address, Firebase will send a password-reset email.
recovery.resultBody: If the address belongs to an account, a password-reset link is on its way.

errors.configuration: The application is not configured. Check the runtime settings.
errors.invalid-credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.email-already-in-use: An account already uses this email address.
errors.weak-password: Choose a stronger password and try again.
errors.email-not-verified: Verify your email address before signing in.
errors.account-unavailable: This ICHU account is unavailable. Sign in instead, or contact your administrator.
errors.service-unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.network: The service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Authentication could not be completed. Try again.

account.title: My account
account.lead: Your verified identity, ranch access, and professional profile.
account.ranchesLead: Ranches your account can open, with the access you hold in each.
account.noRanchesBody: Your account does not have ranch access yet.
account.accessCodeHint: Share this code with your veterinarian so they can request access.
account.profileLead: Details saved for this veterinarian account.
account.editProfileLead: Changes are saved to your ICHU account.
account.profileRequired: Ranch access requests need a complete professional profile. Save your details below.
account.specialtyInvalid: Enter a specialty of up to 120 characters.
account.licenseNumberInvalid: Enter a license number of up to 80 characters.
account.yearsOfExperienceInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 70.

advisories.title: Herd advisories
advisories.lead: Veterinarians request access to a ranch here, and ranch managers review those requests.
advisories.requestLead: Find the ranch with its access code, then explain why you need access.
advisories.profileRequired: Complete your professional profile before requesting access.
advisories.accessCodeHint: Eight characters from the ranch manager's account page.
advisories.accessCodeInvalid: Enter the eight-character code from the ranch manager.
advisories.reasonInvalid: Explain why you need access, up to 1000 characters.
advisories.myRanchesLead: Ranches where your account already has access.
advisories.noMyRanches: You do not have ranch access yet.
advisories.requestsLead: Veterinarian requests for the ranch selected in the header.
advisories.noRanchBody: Access requests appear after your account is assigned to a ranch.
advisories.manageRequiredBody: Your access to the selected ranch does not include reviewing requests.
advisories.noRequestsBody: No veterinarian has asked for access to this ranch.

decision.title: Review access request
decision.lead: Choose the scope and last valid day to grant access, or reject the request.
decision.expiryInvalid: Choose a date from tomorrow onward.

advisories.revokeBody: The veterinarian loses access to this ranch until a new request is granted.

errors.network: The ICHU service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.configuration: The application is not configured. Check the runtime settings.
errors.unknown: The request could not be completed. Try again.
errors.http-403: Your account does not have permission for this action.
errors.http-404: The requested item was not found.
errors.http-409: This change conflicts with existing data. Refresh and try again.
errors.http-500: The ICHU service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

inventory.title: Animals
inventory.lead: Find animals by ear tag, status or lot, register new animals and export the list.
inventory.noRanch: Your account has no ranch access, so no animals are shown.
inventory.empty: No animals are registered in this ranch.
inventory.emptyManage: Register the first animal to start the inventory.
inventory.noMatch: Change or clear the filters to see more animals.

register.title: Register animal
register.lead: Enter the identification and the first productive stage. The ear tag must be unique in this ranch.

edit.title: Edit animal data
edit.lead: Changes keep the animal's stage history.

lifeStage.title: Change productive stage
lifeStage.lead: The previous stage stays in the history and closes on the day you choose.

exit.title: Record exit
exit.warning: Recording an exit cannot be undone. The animal stays in the records as inactive and read-only, with its history.
exit.saved: Exit recorded. The animal is now read-only.

validation.earTagRequired: Enter an ear tag of up to 30 characters.
validation.notInFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
validation.birthDateAfterStage: The birth date cannot be after the first recorded stage.
validation.beforeStage: The date cannot be before the birth date or the start of the current stage.
validation.stageUnchanged: Choose a stage different from the current one.
validation.lotNameRequired: Enter a lot name of up to 80 characters.

profile.title: Animal
profile.readOnly: This animal left the herd on {{date}}. Its record is kept for reference and cannot be changed.
profile.collarUnavailable: Collar data is unavailable right now. Try again later.
profile.assignCollar: Assign a collar in IoT devices
profile.noReadings: No reading has arrived from this collar yet.

errors.versionConflict: This record changed in the meantime. The latest data was loaded.

lots.title: Lots
lots.lead: Group animals for management. An animal can belong to several lots; removing it from a lot keeps its record.
lots.criterionHint: Optional: how the group was formed.
lots.listNote: Select a lot to see its animals.
lots.empty: No lots exist in this ranch.
lots.emptyManage: Create a lot to group animals.
lots.noAssignable: Every active animal is already in this lot.
lots.noAnimals: This lot has no animals yet.

export.failed: The file could not be created. Try again.
export.limited: The export holds the first 5000 animals of the filter.

inventory.title: IoT devices
inventory.lead: Register smart collars and water controllers, assign them to animals and troughs, and track battery, communication, and maintenance.
inventory.noRanch: Your account has no ranch access, so no devices are shown.
inventory.empty: No devices are registered in this ranch.
inventory.emptyManage: Register the first device to start the inventory.
inventory.noMatch: Change or clear the filters to see more devices.

register.title: Register device
register.lead: The serial number is printed on the device and must be unique on the platform.

assign.collarLead: Choose an active animal that has no collar. The collar reports the animal's activity and location.
assign.controllerLead: Choose a water trough that has no controller. The controller reports the trough temperature.
assign.noAnimals: Every active animal already has a collar.
assign.noTroughs: Every water trough already has a controller.

release.title: Release device
release.warning: Releasing ends the current assignment. The device keeps its history and becomes available again.

history.title: Assignment history
history.lead: Every period this device served, newest first.
history.empty: This device has no assignments yet.

errors.versionConflict: This record changed in the meantime. The latest data was loaded.

validation.serialRequired: Enter a serial number of up to 50 characters.
validation.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of up to 120 characters.

list.title: Water troughs
list.lead: Name each drinking place and set the temperature band it will be checked against.
list.empty: No water troughs are registered in this ranch.
list.emptyManage: Register the first water trough to start the list.

register.title: Register water trough
register.lead: Registering a water trough does not use a collar. The lot is optional.

range.title: Set temperature range
range.lead: Set the band the trough will be checked against. Temperature readings are not shown in this version.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
validation.temperatureOrder: The minimum must be lower than the maximum, with at most one decimal.

list.title: Edge gateways
list.lead: Edge gateways connect the field devices of a ranch to ICHU. A gateway key is shown once, when the gateway is registered.
list.empty: No edge gateways are registered in this ranch.
list.emptyManage: Register a gateway to connect a field device.

register.title: Register gateway
register.lead: Name the gateway by where it is on the ranch, such as North paddock.
register.keyWarning: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
register.copyFailed: The key could not be copied. Select it and copy it manually.

revoke.title: Revoke gateway
revoke.warning: The gateway key stops working right away. Revoking cannot be undone; register a new gateway to connect the device again.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
